summary: The invoice's total is at most 10000 EUR (a total above 10000 EUR is a large payment that a manager must review).
rationale: Martín asked to add one rule that escalates (ESCALAR) an invoice whose total is above 10000 EUR so a manager reviews large payments. Encoded as a requirement: it fires when the total is NOT at most 10000 EUR, i.e. when total > 10000 EUR. ESCALAR has priority 3, so it outranks any NO_PAGAR rule that also fires.
